# 2 Chronicles Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-spirit-of God was upon Azariah son-of Oded.

**2** And-he-went-out before Asa and-he-said to-him hear-me Asa and-all Judah and-Benjamin YHWH is-with-you when-you-are with-Him and-if you-seek-Him He-will-be-found by-you and-if you-forsake-Him He-will-forsake you.

**3** And-many days for-Israel without God-of truth and-without priest teaching and-without law.

**4** And-he-turned in-his-distress to YHWH God-of Israel and-they-sought-Him and-He-was-found by-them.

**5** And-in-the-times those there-was-no peace for-the-going-out and-for-the-coming-in for troubles great upon all inhabitants-of the-lands.

**6** And-he-was-crushed nation against-nation and-city against-city for God disturbed-them with-every trouble.

**7** And-you be-strong and-do-not let-drop your-hands for there-is reward for-your-work.

**8** And-as-heard Asa these words and-the-prophecy-of Oded the-prophet he-strengthened-himself and-he-removed the-detestable-things from-all land-of Judah and-Benjamin and-from the-cities that he-captured from-hill-country-of Ephraim and-he-renewed altar-of YHWH that was-before porch-of YHWH.

**9** And-he-gathered all Judah and-Benjamin and-the-sojourners with-them from-Ephraim and-Manasseh and-from-Simeon for they-fell to-him from-Israel in-abundance when-they-saw that YHWH his-God was-with-him.

**10** And-they-gathered to-Jerusalem in-the-month the-third in-year fifteen of-reign-of Asa.

**11** And-they-sacrificed to-YHWH in-the-day that from the-plunder they-brought cattle seven-hundred and-sheep seven-thousand.

**12** And-they-entered into-the-covenant to-seek YHWH God-of their-fathers with-all their-heart and-with-all their-soul.

**13** And-all who not would-seek YHWH God-of Israel shall-be-put-to-death from-small and-to great from-man and-to woman.

**14** And-they-swore to-YHWH with-a-voice great and-with-a-shout and-with-trumpets and-with-horns.

**15** And-they-rejoiced all Judah over the-oath for with-all their-heart they-swore and-with-all their-desire they-sought-Him and-He-was-found by-them and-He-gave-rest YHWH to-them from-all-around.

**16** And-also Maacah mother-of Asa the-king he-removed-her from-queen-mother because she-made for-Asherah a-horrible-image and-he-cut-down Asa her-horrible-image and-he-crushed and-he-burned in-brook Kidron.

**17** And-the-high-places not were-removed from-Israel only heart-of Asa was complete all his-days.

**18** And-he-brought the-holy-things-of his-father and-his-own-holy-things into-house-of God silver and-gold and-vessels.

**19** And-war not was until year thirty-and-five of-reign-of Asa.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **15:2**: YHWH is-with-you when-you-are with-Him — The most concise statement of conditional covenant theology in the Hebrew Bible. God's presence is reciprocal with human faithfulness.

- **15:3-6**: without God-of truth and-without priest teaching — Azariah describes a period of theological collapse: no true God, no teaching priests, no law. The result is social chaos — a warning for the Chronicler's audience.

- **15:13**: shall-be-put-to-death — The covenant includes a death penalty for refusal to seek YHWH. This extreme measure reflects the seriousness of covenantal commitment.


— EMET
